The question asks about fiscal 2025, so for Nike I use the fiscal year ended May 31, 2025 and for Amazon the year ended December 31, 2025.

**Amazon (FY2025):** net income of $77,670M on total net sales of $716,924M gives a net margin of 77,670 / 716,924 = 10.83%.

**Nike (FY2025):** net income of $3,219M on revenues of $46,309M gives a net margin of 3,219 / 46,309 = 6.95%.

**Difference:** 10.83 − 6.95 = 3.88 percentage points.

Amazon had the higher net margin, by about 3.9 percentage points.
